# Dr. Krupali Donda

> Dr. Krupali Donda is an Assistant Professor in the Department of Information and Communication Technology at Adani University, Ahmedabad, specialising in Metamaterials, Metasurfaces, Nanophotonics, Acoustic Metamaterials, and Deep Learning for inverse material design. She received her Ph.D. from Institut Jean Lamour, CNRS, France.

## Key pages

- [Home / Portfolio](https://krupalidonda.com/): Overview of research, teaching and contact details
- [About](https://krupalidonda.com/about): Background, personal journey and academic milestones
- [Research](https://krupalidonda.com/research): Research projects, metasurface design, and deep learning inverse design
- [Publications](https://krupalidonda.com/publications): Peer-reviewed journal articles and conference proceedings
- [Teaching](https://krupalidonda.com/teaching): Courses in Machine Learning, Generative AI, AI, NLP, and Communication
- [Honours and Awards](https://krupalidonda.com/honors): INSA Fellowship, ASA Women in Acoustics Award, ANRF Grant
- [Invited Talks](https://krupalidonda.com/talks): Invited presentations at ASA, META, SVNIT, SPIE and more
- [Research Group](https://krupalidonda.com/group): Current students, interns and alumni
- [Volunteering and Service](https://krupalidonda.com/service): Academic community service and committee roles
- [News and Outreach](https://krupalidonda.com/news-outreach): Latest research highlights and mentorship activities
- [Gallery](https://krupalidonda.com/gallery): Conference photos, lab moments and research milestones
- [Contact](https://krupalidonda.com/contact): Email, office address and academic profiles

## Research areas

- Metamaterials and Metasurfaces
- Wave Propagation
- Nanophotonics
- Acoustic Absorbers
- Deep Learning for Inverse Material Design
- Scientific Machine Learning
- Intelligent Metasurface Design
- Machine Learning for Materials

## Awards and Honours

- Visiting Scientist Fellowship, Indian National Science Academy (INSA), 2025
- Women in Acoustics Emerging Investigator Award, Acoustical Society of America (ASA)
- ANRF International Travel Support Grant, 2026
